subject: Begin homepage redesign in Storybook
body: Open the existing local Storybook and create the first editable implementation pass for the Westside Watch homepage. Start from NewWestsideEditorialHero and the first-scroll homepage structure. Use the existing Westside Watch design system and brand assets. Keep the established Cormorant Garamond and Noto Serif TC typography, dawn-gold and temple-stone visual language, editorial rather than SaaS styling, and clear main-site and Join/Gate navigation. Reuse existing components where appropriate. After implementation, validate that Storybook still builds successfully and return the changed files, validation result, and remaining design issues through the canonical outbox.
